policy.rule: One active task; preserve evidence and platform boundaries; an open PR is in_review, never completed.

tasks.title: PC/N64/Dreamcast complete system evidence matrix
tasks.question: What is established across the three comparative platforms, and what remains unknown?
acceptance_criteria: Evidence is pinned to exact source revisions
Platform-specific findings remain separated
Open PR and exact head are recorded
tasks.next_action: RE-002 matrix is merged. Select the next unresolved PC spline call-path question from live issue #279; do not recreate the matrix.

tasks.title: Native-target complete-game system matrix and PC reference gap audit
tasks.question: What systems must a complete clean-room native port implement, and what is evidenced versus unknown?
acceptance_criteria: Complete-game systems are inventoried
Evidence, inference and unknowns are separated
Source revisions and provenance are recorded
Next research procedure is identified
tasks.next_action: Human review and merge decision; continue with the next unanswered research question rather than recreating the matrix.

tasks.title: Activate and validate persistent autonomous task tracking
tasks.question: Does the merged autonomous loop consistently reconcile the task ledger and avoid duplicate or stale work?
acceptance_criteria: Ledger validator and regression tests pass in CI
Gemini and OpenRouter prompts both reconcile the ledger with live GitHub state
One active task maximum is enforced
A post-merge cycle records exact PR state and continues the next unanswered research question
tasks.next_action: After PR #287 is reviewed and merged, inspect the next scheduled autonomous cycle. Verify its exact-head report, reconcile live PR state, and choose the next unanswered RE-001 research task. Do not repeat readiness or activation steps.

tasks.title: Trace race completion through post-race phases to the Results destination
tasks.question: What is the evidence-backed caller/callee path from per-racer finish through manager-level race completion and post-race phases to the concrete Results panel, substate, or scene/resource transition?
acceptance_criteria: Pin every consulted public source to an exact commit and executable/version context where known
Trace per-racer finish, manager completion condition, post-race phase writer, and Results destination as separate edges
Label each edge by platform and evidence level; do not infer GameCube/Wii behavior from PC or N64 findings
Record unresolved fields, callers, resources and runtime-only questions instead of guessing
Publish one focused research dossier without copying third-party code or game-derived assets
tasks.next_action: After the current automation validation task is verified, use the RE-001 complete-game matrix in PR #282 to trace the race-finish to Results call path from pinned public source evidence; keep platform boundaries explicit and avoid prototype polish.

tasks.title: Require verified evidence for autonomous cycle progress
tasks.question: Do autonomous progress reports correspond to a real open, non-empty same-repository PR at its exact live head?
acceptance_criteria: Gemini and OpenRouter require PROGRESS evidence or a named BLOCKED report
Live GitHub state confirms the PR is open and its head repository is this repository
Live PR head SHA equals the reported 40-character SHA
A missing, forked, stale, closed or empty PR cannot count as progress
tasks.next_action: Review exact-head CI for PR #287, then verify the first real scheduled cycle after merge.

tasks.title: Skip repeated Gemini attempts after an autonomous invocation failure
tasks.question: Can a failed autonomous Gemini model invocation be remembered for the current UTC day so later scheduled cycles skip repeated provider calls and proceed to the separately gated OpenRouter Free fallback?
acceptance_criteria: One persistent marker on issue #226 records the UTC date of an autonomous Gemini CLI invocation failure
A matching same-day marker blocks another autonomous Gemini model request before token mint, checkout and model invocation
The cooldown applies only to autonomous mode; the manual writer path remains unaffected
A cooldown blocks Gemini through the existing fail-closed path so the caller can invoke independently gated OpenRouter Free
The marker is updated in place, expires by date comparison on the next UTC day, and changes no secrets, settings, billing or provider selection
tasks.next_action: After PR #287 is merged, retarget this stacked PR to main, rerun full exact-head safety and provenance checks, inspect independent review, and only then consider merging.

tasks.title: Skip repeated OpenRouter Free requests after autonomous fallback failures
tasks.question: Can a failed autonomous OpenRouter Free invocation be remembered for the current UTC day so later scheduled fallback attempts are skipped until the next UTC day?
acceptance_criteria: One persistent marker on issue #226 records the UTC date of an autonomous OpenRouter Free invocation failure
A matching same-day marker blocks another fallback model request before token mint, checkout, CLI install and model invocation
The fallback cooldown is independent from Gemini's cooldown and does not change its marker
Only a failed OpenCode/OpenRouter invocation records the marker; a blocked preflight does not
The marker is updated in place, expires by date comparison on the next UTC day, and changes no secrets, settings, billing or provider selection
OpenRouter's static AI safety checker and workflow YAML parser validate the new behavior
tasks.next_action: After #289 is integrated, retarget this stacked PR to main, rerun complete exact-head safety and provenance checks, review and merge only when green.
